function: The border-spacing property sets the distance between the borders of adjacent cells.

defaults.Animatable: yes. Read about animatable Try it

values.function: Specifies the distance between the borders of adjacent cells in px, cm, etc. Negative values are not allowed. If one value is specified, it defines both the horizontal and vertical spacing between cells If two values are specified, the first sets the horizontal spacing and the second sets the vertical spacing
